verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a billing platform, but the evidence pack documents no first-party export of merchant data in open formats and no offboarding path. The only migration evidence covers moving into Polar from an existing store. The API, SDKs, MCP server and open-source codebase are developer building blocks that could be used to build an export, not a documented export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
